property: refuses a vacuous pass - an empty or missing skills root must not report success
limits: Covers the VACUITY property only: an empty or missing skills root must not report success. It does NOT establish that harness-lint still detects unadapted Claude-only constructs - the 0f0491d anchor CATCHES those (exit 1, identical to the current gate), so they cannot be anchored against it and need their own control. A PASS here says one rule of seven is proven, not that the gate is sound.

cases.name: vacuous-root
cases.why: a skill directory carrying no markdown. Nothing is examined, so a pass here would prove nothing.

cases.name: populated-root
cases.why: one clean markdown file. Separates a working gate from one wedged at refuse.

anchors.why: the pre-#245 gate. Measured blind on the vacuous root: exit 0, 'harness-lint: 0 markdown file(s) passed'.
